issues.description: The problem statement explicitly instructs that the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) should be public for testing, but both the template and the solution declare this method as private (and the template currently has the parameter commented out). This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the required method accessibility and may cause tests or grading infrastructure that expect a public helper method to fail or be unable to call it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) method public and ensure its parameter uses the Animal type in the template (and update the solution if tests require public access). This aligns code visibility with the problem statement and allows external tests to invoke the helper method.
